crossRefs.note: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

parallels.note: Likewise the chief priests also mocking, with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

translations.web: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.
translations.bsb: In the same way, the chief priests and scribes mocked Him among themselves, saying, “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself!
translations.kjv: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
translations.asv: In like manner also the chief priests mocking him among themselves with the scribes said, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
